name: dirichlet_grad
description: Representative upstream schema: aten::_dirichlet_grad(Tensor x, Tensor alpha, Tensor total) -> Tensor. The artifact maps to the private canonical base _dirichlet_grad and computes the reparameterized Dirichlet gradient without mutating or aliasing its inputs. Tests cover float32/float64 simplex inputs across concentration and category regimes, output metadata, numerical agreement, input preservation, and rejection of nonbroadcastable shapes.
